features.name: high_variance_feature_mean
features.description: Mean of features with high variance (V6, V8, V9, V12, V15, V17) that tend to have heavy right tails, capturing overall complexity signal
features.expected_model_benefit: Provides a smooth composite score summarizing high-variance dimensions useful for linear margin separation

features.name: low_variance_feature_mean
features.description: Mean of features with low variance (V33, V43) that have small std, capturing a different signal regime
features.expected_model_benefit: Captures low-variance signal dimensions that may linearly separate certain groups

features.name: l2_norm_first_block
features.description: L2 norm of first 10 features (V1-V10), representing overall magnitude in the first feature block
features.expected_model_benefit: Provides a smooth continuous magnitude measure useful as a linear projection component

features.name: l2_norm_second_block
features.description: L2 norm of features V11-V20, representing overall magnitude in the second feature block
features.expected_model_benefit: Captures magnitude in a different feature subspace, complementing the first block norm for linear separation

features.name: sparse_tail_score
features.description: Count of features exceeding 2 standard deviations from zero (proxy for outlier/extreme feature activations), normalized by total features
features.expected_model_benefit: Measures how many features are in extreme ranges, providing a smooth sparsity-like score for linear SVM

features.name: positive_feature_ratio
features.description: Ratio of features V1-V25 that are positive, indicating directional bias in the feature space
features.expected_model_benefit: Captures the proportion of positive-valued features as a smooth ratio useful for linear margin computation

features.name: log1p_heavy_tail_composite
features.description: Log1p-transformed sum of absolute values of heavy-tailed features (V9, V12, V15, V17, V21, V22, V28, V29) to compress extreme values
features.expected_model_benefit: Compresses heavy-tailed distributions into a smooth score, improving linear separability by reducing outlier influence
features.formula: np.log1p(np.abs(V9) + np.abs(V12) + np.abs(V15) + np.abs(V17) + np.abs(V21) + np.abs(V22) + np.abs(V28) + np.abs(V29))

features.name: feature_range_spread
features.description: Difference between max and min of a selected subset of features (V1,V3,V5,V7,V9,V11,V13,V15), measuring within-row spread
features.expected_model_benefit: Captures within-row feature spread as a continuous measure, useful for linear SVM to distinguish compact vs dispersed feature profiles
features.formula: np.maximum(np.maximum(np.maximum(np.maximum(np.maximum(np.maximum(np.maximum(V1, V3), V5), V7), V9), V11), V13), V15) - np.minimum(np.minimum(np.minimum(np.minimum(np.minimum(np.minimum(np.minimum(V1, V3), V5), V7), V9), V11), V13), V15)

features.name: weighted_composite_score
features.description: Weighted linear combination of selected features emphasizing those with larger variance (V6, V9, V12, V20, V22, V28) with log1p compression
features.expected_model_benefit: Provides an approximate linear projection that emphasizes high-information features, directly useful as a linear SVM input dimension

features.name: negative_feature_magnitude
features.description: Sum of absolute values of features that are predominantly negative (V2, V7, V14, V32, V45, V51), capturing negative-direction signal strength
features.expected_model_benefit: Captures the magnitude of features with negative bias, providing a complementary linear component to positive-direction features
features.formula: np.abs(V2) + np.abs(V7) + np.abs(V14) + np.abs(V32) + np.abs(V45) + np.abs(V51)

features.name: feature_block_ratio
features.description: Ratio of mean absolute value of features V26-V51 to mean absolute value of features V1-V25, measuring relative signal strength between blocks
features.expected_model_benefit: Captures relative signal distribution between feature blocks as a smooth ratio, useful for linear SVM to detect block-level patterns
features.formula: (np.abs(V26) + np.abs(V27) + np.abs(V28) + np.abs(V29) + np.abs(V30) + np.abs(V31) + np.abs(V32) + np.abs(V33) + np.abs(V34) + np.abs(V35) + np.abs(V36) + np.abs(V37) + np.abs(V38) + np.abs(V39) + np.abs(V40) + np.abs(V41) + np.abs(V42) + np.abs(V43) + np.abs(V44) + np.abs(V45) + np.abs(V46) + np.abs(V47) + np.abs(V48) + np.abs(V49) + np.abs(V50) + np.abs(V51)) / (np.abs(V1) + np.abs(V2) + np.abs(V3) + np.abs(V4) + np.abs(V5) + np.abs(V6) + np.abs(V7) + np.abs(V8) + np.abs(V9) + np.abs(V10) + np.abs(V11) + np.abs(V12) + np.abs(V13) + np.abs(V14) + np.abs(V15) + np.abs(V16) + np.abs(V17) + np.abs(V18) + np.abs(V19) + np.abs(V20) + np.abs(V21) + np.abs(V22) + np.abs(V23) + np.abs(V24) + np.abs(V25) + 1e-6)

features.name: semantic_complexity_score
features.description: Semantic assessment of overall feature complexity based on the combination of high-magnitude features, spread, and tail behavior. Higher scores indicate more complex feature profiles with many extreme values and high inter-feature variability, suggesting harder theorem proving instances.
features.expected_model_benefit: Provides a holistic complexity signal that captures non-linear interactions between feature extremity, spread, and magnitude in a single smooth score for linear SVM
